6.273 rsInvalidBackgroundGradientType
rsInvalidBackgroundGradientType is a critical error that occurs when a Style.BackgroundGradientType
element is set to a constant String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.1) that is not one of its valid values.
